snippet.title: COGHEIM — Official Announcement Game Trailer | "The Ground Remembers"
snippet.description:
Discover COGHEIM, an upcoming steampunk 4X strategy MMO where entire cities walk. Watch the official trailer. Coming 2027.

The world didn’t end. It started walking.

In the year 2526, colossal Strider fortresses carry the last of humanity across a broken world. These walking cities are civilization’s last refuge.

Join a Syndicate. Hold the line. Nothing walking is lost.

Follow COGHEIM’s development and get updates ahead of release:
▸ Official website & newsletter: https://cogheim.com
▸ Join the Discord community: https://discord.gg/AE2RTC2U9X

EXPLORE THE WORLD
▸ The Cogheim Quintet novels: https://cogheim.com/books

—
“The Ground Remembers”
Original song written and produced for COGHEIM.

Developed by Limitless Game Makers LLC.
▸ Studio website: https://www.limitlessgamemakers.com

#COGHEIM #Steampunk #MMO #4XStrategy #GameTrailer
